# Wilson Center

> > The Woodrow Wilson International Center for Scholars is a nonpartisan policy forum tackling global issues through research, dialogue, and scholarship on international affairs, security, and governance.

The Wilson Center brings together scholars, policymakers, and experts to analyze critical challenges spanning U.S. foreign policy, regional conflicts, energy cooperation, democratic transitions, and international security. Through its regional programs and fellowship initiatives, the Center produces research and hosts dialogues on topics from Middle East counterterrorism to Asian urbanization to Latin American security reform.

## Key Topics

- U.S. foreign policy
- Middle East policy and counterterrorism
- U.S.-China relations and clean energy cooperation
- Afghanistan and Pakistan relations
- Iraq War and reconstruction
- Africa Program and regional governance
- Latin American citizen security
- Democratic transitions and Orange Revolution
- United Nations peacekeeping
- NAFTA and North American relations
- Climate policy and carbon emissions
- Asian mega-cities and urbanization
- Berlin Wall and Cold War history
- Pulitzer Prize-winning scholarship

## Middle East and Counterterrorism

- [Obama Gets Osama: Nothing Succeeds Like Success](https://www.wilsoncenter.org/article/obama-gets-osama-nothing-succeeds-success): Analysis of Osama bin Laden operation's impact on U.S. Middle East strategy
- [Scholar Assesses U.S. Security Beyond Iraq](https://www.wilsoncenter.org/article/scholar-assesses-us-security-beyond-iraq): David Sanger writes security primer examining post-Iraq global challenges
- [Learning from our Mistakes](https://www.wilsoncenter.org/article/learning-our-mistakes): Lee Hamilton discusses U.S. government capacity gaps in Iraq reconstruction

## U.S.-China Relations and Energy

- [Seeking Greater U.S.-China Clean Energy Cooperation](https://www.wilsoncenter.org/article/seeking-greater-us-china-clean-energy-cooperation): Scholar Merritt Cooke examines U.S.-China clean energy cooperation potential

## Regional Crises and Governance

- [Japan Faces Worst Crisis in Postwar Era](https://www.wilsoncenter.org/article/japan-faces-worst-crisis-postwar-era): Scholar Nobuo Fukuda analyzes 2011 earthquake, tsunami, and Fukushima crisis
- [The Orange Revolution and the Maydan Parliament](https://www.wilsoncenter.org/article/the-orange-revolution-and-the-maydan-parliament): Ambassador Miller shares firsthand account of Ukraine's Orange Revolution
- [Beyond Metropolis: Governing Asia's Mega-Cities](https://www.wilsoncenter.org/article/beyond-metropolis-governing-asias-mega-cities): Fellow Aprodicio Laquian examines governance of Asia's mega-urban regions

## Africa Program

- [Africa Program Partners with the Burundi Leadership Training Program to Gather Key Burundian Leaders, Help End Political Stalemate](https://www.wilsoncenter.org/article/africa-program-partners-the-burundi-leadership-training-program-to-gather-key-burundian): Africa Program hosts Burundi leaders retreat to resolve political stalemate
- [Envoy Hails Clinton's Trip to Africa, Focus On Hunger, AGOA](https://www.wilsoncenter.org/article/envoy-hails-clintons-trip-to-africa-focus-hunger-agoa): Sierra Leone envoy discusses Clinton's Africa visit focusing on food security
- [Peace at last in Congo---if UN plays a role](https://www.wilsoncenter.org/article/peace-last-congo-if-un-plays-role): Howard Wolpe argues for UN peacekeeping role in Congo conflict resolution

## Latin America and Security

- [Enhancing Citizen Security in Latin America](https://www.wilsoncenter.org/article/enhancing-citizen-security-latin-america): Fellow Mark Ungar researches police reform across four Latin American nations
- [NAFTA and the New North American Summitry](https://www.wilsoncenter.org/article/nafta-and-the-new-north-american-summitry): Scholar Louis Belanger analyzes North American summits' role in NAFTA support

## About the Wilson Center

- [Point of View: Wilson Center Activities](https://www.wilsoncenter.org/article/point-view-wilson-center-activities): Deputy Director describes Wilson Center's scholarly activities and programs
- [Wilson Center Congratulates Its Pulitzer Prize-Winning Scholars](https://www.wilsoncenter.org/article/wilson-center-congratulates-its-pulitzer-prize-winning-scholars): Wilson Center scholars Sheri Fink and Anthony Shadid win 2010 Pulitzer Prizes

## Optional

- [On Walls: 20 Years After the Berlin Wall](https://www.wilsoncenter.org/article/walls-20-years-after-the-berlin-wall): Commemoration of Berlin Wall's 20th anniversary and Cold War division
- [The Privilege of dialogue](https://www.wilsoncenter.org/article/the-privilege-dialogue): Producer John Tyler reflects on Dialogue radio/TV series and book publication
- [Rethinking the Economics of War: The Intersection of Need, Creed, and Greed](https://www.wilsoncenter.org/article/rethinking-the-economics-war-the-intersection-need-creed-and-greed): Wilson Center Press publishes book on economics behind internal conflicts
- [Former Wilson Center Scholar Jeffrey Kimball Wins Link-Kuehl Prize](https://www.wilsoncenter.org/article/former-wilson-center-scholar-jeffrey-kimball-wins-link-kuehl-prize): Jeffrey Kimball's Vietnam War book wins Link-Kuehl documentary editing prize
- [Dialogue Radio and TV Honored for Programming Excellence](https://www.wilsoncenter.org/article/dialogue-radio-and-tv-honored-for-programming-excellence): Wilson Center's Dialogue program wins 2004 Telly Award for excellence
- [Partnership and Security](https://www.wilsoncenter.org/article/partnership-and-security): BAE Systems chairman discusses U.S.-UK defense partnership and globalization
